thread:
incident-bot: ALERT: gpu-serving-pool-3/node-42 — CUDA illegal memory access (misaligned device address) detected in container `redwood-serving-123`. Multiple restarts observed, not yet full OOM but risk of cascade. Pager notified: @jordan (oncall).

jordan (oncall): grabbing it. pinging infra and runtime.

maya (swe): seeing 502s and retry spikes from that AZ starting ~15:21 UTC. small fraction of requests failing.

liu (ml infra): pulling kernel logs now. preliminary look shows a pagewalk error + deviceaddr fault around the crash timestamps.

ops-bot: Auto-remediation triggered: scaled down 1 pod due to CrashLoopBackOff, annotated pod `incident/active=true`.

alex (support): customer A and customer C reported increased latency and occasional 500s. I have a support blurb ready to send after triage.

jordan (oncall): plan: cordon node-42 and drain, failover pods to standby nodes. will collect previous logs and coredumps first.

maya (swe): suggest immediate traffic split to fallback model (quantized-model-v2) at 50% to reduce risk while we investigate.

liu (ml infra): collecting artifacts. commands i'm running:
```
sudo sysctl -w kernel.panic_on_oops=0
sudo kubectl -n prod cordon node-42
sudo kubectl drain node-42 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data --force
nvidia-smi -q -d MEMORY,DRIVER > /tmp/nvidia-snap.log
kubectl logs -n prod redwood-serving-123 --previous > /tmp/rs-prev.log\```

jordan (oncall): cordon + drain done. pods evicted and restarted on other nodes, transient 10-20s error spike during reschedule. node-42 left unschedulable.

ops-bot: Incident ticket INC-2026-1397 created and assigned to `eng-runtime`.

ben (sre): rolling back the recent model prefetch/reload that went out in the 12:59 deploy — that flagged prefetch kernel arg that could cause concurrent pagewalks.

maya (swe): 👍 keeping fallback traffic at 50% until we confirm stability. will watch latency p95 too.

liu (ml infra): kernel trace excerpt (sanitized):
```
[ 1234.567890] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:00:1): 62, PID=9876: GPU pagefault: Invalid granularity in address walk
[ 1234.567993] cuda: illegal memory access at 0x7fffa12b0000
[ 1234.568100] kernel: pagewalk: unexpected descriptor, smmu get_pte failed
```

jordan (oncall): monitoring update: error rate down to ~0.12% since failover and rollback. no active customer escalations.

alex (support): posting immediate customer notice draft to #customer-impact for review, will send once confirmed stable.

liu (ml infra): next steps: collect full oops logs, upload nvcrash and /var/crash, attempt controlled repro with the prefetch toggle disabled, escalate to kernel team if repro reproducible. marking as P1 until node repro confirmed.

jordan (oncall): handing off to runtime oncall @maya for postmortem and followups. I'll stay looped for infra actions.

maya (swe): taking lead. i'll document timeline, commands, and remediation steps. will add a postmortem to the incidents folder after 24h and assign action items (revert flag, kernel debug, canary for prefetch).

incident-bot: Incident updated — severity=P1, status=mitigated (traffic diverted), start_ts=1719876543, handler=maya.

ben (sre): summary note: suspected root cause = kernel pagewalk race introduced by prefetch kernel flag + concurrent model reload pattern; action items = revert reload, gather repro, kernel escalation, add traffic canary for prefetch toggles.

maya (swe): thanks all — neat coordination. leaving node quarantined and keeping rollback in place until kernel eng signs off. will follow up with postmortem and customer notes.
